title: Aligning Training and Rollout Policies for End-to-End FP4 RL on Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.04376v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this work, we study end-to-end FP4 reinforcement learning (RL) post-training for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models. Recent work on FP4 RL has introduced effective recovery recipes that restore accuracy under aggressive low-precision quantization for dense models, but we find that the same approach yields no improvement over the naive FP4 baseline in the MoE setting. We conduct an in-depth study to understand why. Our analysis identifies the root cause in the routing mechanism unique to MoE: because the router makes discrete expert-selection decisions, training-inference policy alignment becomes acutely sensitive to whether the same recovery technique is applied symmetrically on the training and inference sides. When an asymmetric recipe is used-including the dense-model approach, which corrects only the rollout-training-inference alignment deteriorates sharply, as measured by the Pearson correlation coefficient

translated_title: 面向混合专家大语言模型端到端FP4强化学习的训练与推理策略对齐
translated_abstract: 本研究探讨了面向混合专家大语言模型的端到端FP4（四比特浮点）强化学习后训练。近期关于FP4强化学习的工作提出了有效的恢复方案，能够在激进低精度量化下恢复稠密模型的精度，但我们发现同样的方法在MoE场景下相比朴素的FP4基线没有任何提升。我们开展了深入研究以理解其中的原因。我们的分析发现其根本原因在于MoE模型独有的路由机制：由于路由器做出的是离散的专家选择决策，训练与推理策略的对齐对训练端和推理端是否对称地应用相同的恢复技术变得极为敏感。当使用非对称方案时——包括那种仅修正rollout/训练侧的稠密模型方法——训练与推理策略的对齐会急剧恶化（以皮尔逊相关系数衡量）。
tldr: 该研究揭示了MoE大模型FP4强化学习失效的根源在于路由器的离散专家选择机制，证明了必须在训练与推理两侧对称地应用相同的恢复技术，才能实现有效的端到端FP4强化学习。
en_tdlr: This work identifies the discrete expert-selection routing mechanism as the root cause of policy misalignment in FP4 RL for MoE LLMs, showing that recovery recipes must be applied symmetrically on both training and rollout sides to achieve effective end-to-end FP4 reinforcement learning.
